Name: Emily HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]💙 Emily HD Portraits by Hemptress
Give Stardew Valley’s resident blue-haired dreamer a vibrant HD makeover. ✨
[b]Emily HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] reimagines Emily in my signature semi-realistic portrait style while keeping the colorful, expressive personality that makes her instantly recognizable.
Her vivid cobalt hair, bright magenta eyes, playful expressions, and wonderfully eccentric energy have all been redesigned with richer detail, softer rendering, and a more mature, glamorous aesthetic.
Whether she's smiling behind the Stardrop Saloon bar, getting emotional during a conversation, or enjoying Ginger Island, Emily now has a portrait set with a little extra sparkle. 💙🌸[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Portraiture[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [b]Emily HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the portrait folder inside your Portraiture portrait packs directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Use Portraiture's portrait-selection controls in game to select the [b]Hemptress Emily[/b] portrait set.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]If another portrait pack is currently selected, simply cycle through your available Portraiture packs until this one appears.[/color]

[/list][heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]🌺 Ginger Island / Beach Portraits[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]Emily also receives a separate tropical portrait look for Ginger Island.
Her island portraits feature a more playful, summery aesthetic while maintaining the same face, hairstyle, proportions, and overall visual style as the main portrait set.
Because even mystical fashion queens deserve vacation portraits. 🌴✨[/color]

[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]💙 Style[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]My goal with this portrait series is not to completely redesign Stardew Valley's characters.
Instead, I want them to feel like detailed HD interpretations of the characters we already know, with:
[b]more expression
more detail
more personality
and just a little extra ✨hotness✨[/b]
Emily's whimsical, confident, kindhearted personality was especially important to preserve.[/color]
